description_zh: 修改一个云盘异步复制关系
kebab_example: aliyun ebs modify-disk-replica-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-pair-id pair-cn-dsa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDiskReplicaPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the primary or secondary disk in the replication pair. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html to query the regions that support async replication
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系中主盘或从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair
parameters.name: replica_pair_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the replication pair
parameters.name: pair_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the replication pair
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value for this parameter from your client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth for async replication, in Kbps.

This parameter is not yet available
parameters.help_zh:
带宽值，单位Kbps。
该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group. Unit: seconds. Currently, only a value of 900 is supported
parameters.help_zh: 一致性组设定的RPO值，单位：秒。当前仅支持900秒
parameters.name: rpo

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

false: Disables RTC.

true: Enables RTC.

Default value: false.

If a replication pair is part of a replication group, its RTC setting is the same as the setting of the group
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启复制时间控制（RTC）。取值范围：

false：关闭。
true：开启。

默认false。

若复制对已加入复制组，则与复制组的属性保持一致
parameters.name: enable_rtc
